parameters.query:
-- Upsert: the status can arrive before "Remember sent" in the alerts
-- workflow has saved the message. A status only moves forward (a late
-- 'delivered' never overwrites 'read' or 'failed'), so Meta's retries of
-- one it already sent change nothing and return no row.
INSERT INTO whatsapp_messages AS w (wamid, title, status, status_at, error)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, to_timestamp($4), $5)
ON CONFLICT (wamid) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status, status_at = EXCLUDED.status_at,
  error = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.error, w.error), title = COALESCE(w.title, EXCLUDED.title)
WHERE array_position(ARRAY['accepted', 'sent', 'delivered', 'read', 'failed'], EXCLUDED.status) > array_position(ARRAY['accepted', 'sent', 'delivered', 'read', 'failed'], w.status)
RETURNING wamid, title, sent_at, status, error

-- Failed alerts of the last 7 days not resent yet, oldest first, 30 at a
-- time. Marked in the same statement, so two quick messages from the owner
-- never resend the same alert twice.
UPDATE whatsapp_messages SET resent_at = now()
WHERE wamid IN (
  SELECT wamid FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE status = 'failed' AND resent_at IS NULL AND message IS NOT NULL
    AND sent_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  ORDER BY sent_at LIMIT 30
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
RETURNING wamid, title, message, sent_at
